title: Potatoverse Body Symbolism Map
status: project symbolic anatomy with explicit scientific boundary
purpose: Consolidate the project's body correspondences so thalamus, pineal, heart, spine, CSF, Eye and House imagery remain distinguishable rather than being flattened into one brain-centered metaphor.
scientific_boundary: Literal anatomy and neuroscience must remain separate from Potatoverse symbolism. The correspondences below are project interpretations unless a field explicitly states a biological fact.

symbols.function: feeling, emotional weight, attachment, care and affective orientation
symbols.importance: This is an explicit project correction: later thalamus/pineal models must not erase Heart's separate emotional function.

symbols.function: symbolic House architecture and upper organizing center
symbols.science_note: The thalamus is a deep brain structure with multiple nuclei and major sensory/cortical relay and integration functions; calling it Father's House is symbolic.

symbols.project_role: Son / Single Eye / Door in later mapping
symbols.function: symbolic illumination, threshold and present-facing interface
symbols.science_note: The pineal gland is an endocrine structure involved in melatonin/circadian regulation; third-eye and Door meanings are historical/esoteric/project symbolism, not established neuroscience.

symbols.function: vertical bodily analogue for ordered ascent/descent and level change
symbols.science_note: The vertebral column is anatomical support/protection; the project's 33-level symbolism should not be represented as proof of 33 spiritual levels.

symbols.project_role: flow / Spirit imagery in one developed layer
symbols.science_note: Cerebrospinal fluid has real physiological functions; its spiritual use is metaphorical.

symbols.function: the point from which a system can symbolically observe or know itself
symbols.science_note: Do not collapse ordinary vision, pineal symbolism and the project's abstract Eye into one biological organ claim.

symbols.function: holds differentiated rooms, flows, thresholds and vertical relations

relational_model.heart_brain: Emotion and integrative/perceptual processing are distinct functions that may interact; symbolic integration should preserve rather than erase that distinction.
relational_model.house_eye: Thalamus/House and pineal/Eye are neighboring symbols in some project layers but should not be treated as identical.
relational_model.spine_house: The vertical spine/Ladder is a different analogue from the upper House/Eye architecture; one connects levels while the other represents an upper container/center.
relational_model.breath_flow: Older project material uses breath and fluid/river imagery to animate otherwise static body geometry; this belongs to a flow metaphor rather than a literal hidden energy claim.

research_questions: When did the project first distinguish Heart from brain-centered symbolism?
Which thalamic nuclei/room analogies are explicitly project-defined and which were later elaborations?
When did Pineal become Son/Door rather than a general illumination symbol?
How does the spine/33 Ladder layer differ chronologically from the later Axis formalism?
Which body correspondences are stable canon and which are developmental experiments?
